description:
Your home is your sanctuary. Keeping it that way takes a little extra attention and some TLC.  I'll show you the hazards to be aware of and how doing the little things can go a long way in your home.

Hi, I'm Chris, your friendly neighbor the Wolf. Home safety and efficiency nerd. Home danger usually isn't dramatic. It's the outlet behind the couch or the AC filter nobody's changed in a year. Same with your wallet: a leaky faucet costs a few dollars a month, and a neglected HVAC can cost thousands. I'll help you catch both with a few laughs.

At Everything Home Guide, we share simple fixes for everyday problems: hazards behind fires, floods, and ER visits, plus cleaning and storage tips, energy and water savings, and making your HVAC and appliances last longer. No contractor required (fingers crossed).

Subscribe and let's get your home in order!

⚠️ General safety education only, not professional advice. Consult a licensed professional for repairs, and call 911 in an emergency.
